Team —

Reminder: our monthly pipeline sweep window opens today and leadership needs the assembled QBR packet by EOD Wednesday (6/16). This thread is the operational checklist; please use the attached QBR_packet_template_v3.xlsx and the shared Drive folder below. High-level asks: 

• Update stage in Salesforce for every active opportunity that you own (make sure Stage and Commit Reason fields are populated).
• Add a 1–2 line commit rational for any deal listed as Commit or Upside.
• Export top 10 deals into the CSV template and attach to your manager response.
• Mark deals that require finance validation with the tag "finance-check" in the notes.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqQBR-Templates/leadership-packets
Attachment: QBR_packet_template_v3.xlsx (template)

Please reply to this thread with the following by EOD Tuesday (6/15):
- Confirmation you ran stage updates for your owned opps
- Top 10 CSV attached (or a note if you have fewer than 10 active deals)
- Any deals needing an SLA exception or redline approval

I'll collate and run a quick pass Wednesday morning before sending to execs.

— Jordan
